summary: ENGINE.py SOURCE_WEIGHT fallback is 1.0 — the maximum weight (equal to 'plugins'). Any unit with source_id='' (default), 'symbolic_sources', or any unregistered id silently scores at the top tier. symbolic_sources/ corpus has no registered source_id in sources.py. No tests cover this fallback path.
evidence: helen_os/knowledge/sources.py:39-61 — SOURCES registry: 3 entries only; no 'symbolic_sources' entry
helen_os/knowledge/symbolic_sources/ — 6 files present; no source_id registered for this corpus
helen_os/tests/ — zero tests assert SOURCE_WEIGHT fallback behavior or source_id coverage
mechanism: ingest_corpus(source_id='') is the default call signature. Any unit missing explicit source tagging gets source_id=''. At retrieval, source_w=SOURCE_WEIGHT.get('', 1.0)=1.0 — equal to plugins (highest). Unregistered symbolic content outranks helen_os codebase (0.9) and apple_notes (0.8) silently.
hypothesis: If SOURCE_WEIGHT fallback is lowered from 1.0 to 0.5 (below all registered sources), untagged and unknown-source units will rank below all registered corpus boundaries, preventing silent promotion of unvetted content.
proposed_tweak: helen_os/knowledge/engine.py line 342: change 'SOURCE_WEIGHT.get(unit.source_id, 1.0)' to 'SOURCE_WEIGHT.get(unit.source_id, 0.5)'. Proposal only — operator must apply. Optionally add 'symbolic_sources' entry to SOURCE_WEIGHT at 0.3 (below all three registered sources) to match T4/T6 floor doctrine.

keep_rule: KEEP if: empty-source unit scores below all registered sources AND existing retrieval tests (test_knowledge_vector_index.py, test_knowledge_vector_gate.py) stay green. REJECT if: any existing test depends on unknown sources ranking at 1.0.
